mapper.sql: chart_account_groups.id AS id, chart_account_groups.name AS name, chart_account_groups.chart_account_type_id AS accountTypeId, chart_account_types.name AS accountTypeName, chart_account_groups.is_active AS status, is_depreciation AS expense, DATE_FORMAT(chart_account_groups.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(chart_account_groups.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy
